审稿报告 ]\\n Overall: 3.0 审稿报告 — Round 6 (Fresh) 论文 : \\\"Beyond Self-Consistency: Why Self-Extracted Symbolic Constraints Fail in LLM Reasoning\\\"\\n Venue : EMNLP 2026 (ARR May 2026 cycle)\\n Deadline 论文提出 SICA（Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation），从 K 条 CoT traces 中提取 FOL 约束并通过 Z3 加权 partial MAX-SAT 选择答案，系统评估其在 6 个模型（7B–32B）、3 个推理域、~ 1,250 unique instances 上的表现。核心发现为负面结果：自提取约束无法超越 SC 多数投票。论文提出 self-correct\\\" 的定性结论，为社区理解自验证失败的具体机制提供了可操作的诊断工具。 S3: CJT + Effective-K 框架提供有价值的分析透镜。  [ R2-S2, R1-S5 ]\\n 将 Condorcet Jury Theorem 引入 LLM trace 分析，Effective-K 指标直观量化了\\\"额外采样的边际收益递减\\\"。跨 4 种聚合方法和 3 个模型族的 κ ≥ 0.40 ceiling（Table 3）支撑了 independence bottleneck 的普遍性。 S4: 写作结构清晰，统计报告完整。  [ R1-S6, R2-S5 ]\\n 正文 8 页内容密度高，Contribution 列表精确对应后续 sections。McNemar exact test、bootstrap CI、power ceiling，为论文从纯负面转向有条件的正面展望提供了实验支撑。 Weaknesses Must-Fix W1: 统计功效严重不足，标题 \\\"Fail\\\" 过度断言。  [ R1-W1(must-fix), R2-AGREE ]\\n Power analysis（Appendix E）显示 observed power 仅 5.7%–20.6%，MDE 为 4.64–8.84pp。如果 SICA 真实效应为 1–2pp（对 reasoning benchmark 已属 meaningful），当前样本量根本无法检测到。标题 \\\"Fail\\\" 和 abstract \\\"fail to surpass majority voting\\\" 是 evidence of absence 的措辞，但统计证据仅支持 absence of evidence。 -  修复方案 : (1) 对 confirmatory conditions 运行 TOST equivalence test（margin ±2pp）——若 TOST 显著拒绝效应 ≥2pp 的假设，可有底气声称 \\\"no practically meaningful improvement\\\"；(2) 若 TOST 不显著，软化语言：\\\"...provide no detectable improvement at current sample sizes\\\" 或 \\\"...do not yield statistically significant gains\\\"；(3) 标题改为 \\\"Why Self-Extracted Symbolic Constraints Do Not Improve LLM Reasoning\\\"。 W2: 跨架构 PoC 多重比较未校正。  [ R1-W2(must-fix), R2-AGREE ]\\n DeBERTa 在 2 datasets × 3+ weight configurations 上测试。ProofWriter w=3 的 p=0.013 在 Bonferroni（6 comparisons, threshold 0.0083）下不再显著；仅 w=5 的 p <0.001 可能存活。论文未报告任何多重比较校正。 -  修复方案 : 报告 Bonferroni/BH 校正后 p 值，或明确标注 §6 为 exploratory analysis。以 ProofWriter w=5（p <0.001，校正后仍显著）为主要证据。 W3: 核心发现与 self-correction/self-verification 文献的区分不足。  [ R2-W1(must-fix), R1-partial-rebut ]\\n \\\"Symbolic Confirmation Bias\\\" 本质上是 Huang et al. (2024) self-correction failure 和 Stechly et al. (2025) self-verification failure 在符号域的具体实例化。论文引用了这些工作但未充分论证其增量贡献。R1 部分反驳：认为定量框架（κ, Effective-K, BR）本身有价值；R2 坚持需要更清晰的区分。 -  修复方案 : 在 Introduction 或 §7 增加段落，明确对比 (a) Huang/Stechly 的定性结论 vs (b) 本文的定量贡献（Effective-K 框架、BR 指标作为诊断工具、process-level independence 发现形式验证也无法突破 confirmation bias）。 W4: 关键相关工作缺失。  [ R2-W2(must-fix), R1-AGREE ] -  CLOVER  (Ryu et al., ICLR 2025): compositional FOL translation + SAT verification，在 7 个逻辑推理 benchmark 上 SOTA。与 SICA pipeline 直接相关——为什么 compositional translation 有效而 self-extraction 失败？ -  VERGE  (arXiv 2601.20055): SMT solver iterative refinement -  \\\"Not All Votes Count! Programs as Verifiers\\\"  (Xia et al., 2024): programs-as-verifiers 增强 SC -  \\\"Logical Soundness is not a Reliable Criterion...\\\"  (arXiv 2604.04177): LLM formal logic 系统性失败 position paper -  修复方案 : 在 §2 Neuro-symbolic reasoning 段落补充 CLOVER 和 VERGE，讨论 compositional translation vs free-form extraction 的对比。 Should-Fix W5: CJT 框架应用不够严谨——Fleiss' κ 作为 ICC proxy 有统计学问题。  [ R1-W3(should-fix), R2-Q3, 共识 ]\\n Fleiss' κ 是名义尺度一致性指标，与 Ladha (1992) 意义上的投票者相关系数统计含义不同。Kish (1965) design-effect 公式假设等相关结构（constant pairwise correlation），在 LLM traces 中未被验证。论文已添加 \\\"qualitative proxy\\\" 声明，但 K_ eff 数值仍被大量用于定量推断。 -  修复方案 : (a) 补充 pairwise vote correlation 作为替代/交叉验证指标；(b) 或弱化 CJT 框架的定量角色至 conceptual motivation。 W6: Bias ratio 报告不一致。  [ R1-W4(should-fix) ]\\n §5.2 报告 4.97× raw / 4.24× weighted，跨模型 \\\"1.97×, 3.93×, 2.88×\\\" raw——但 Table 14 中 weighted 数字为 2.14/3.05/2.86×。4.97× 的计算范围（哪个条件、pooled 还是单条件）不明确。 -  修复方案 : 在 §5.2 明确标注 4.97× 的计算条件和 raw/weighted 区别，Table 14 同时报告两种 ratio。 W7: Type A/B/C failure mode 分类为 post-hoc 但呈现为理论框架。  [ R1-W5(should-fix), R2-AGREE ]\\n SC 准确率阈值（60%, 40%）无理论推导或 sensitivity 分析。 -  修复方案 : 明确标注为 post-hoc empirical taxonomy。 W8: Process-Level Independence 的 TF-IDF cosine similarity 过于粗糙。  [ R2-W3(should-fix), R1-Q3, 共识 ]\\n TF-IDF 只捕获 lexical overlap，无法区分语义相似但表述不同的推理路径。论文已声明 \\\"lower bound\\\"，但作为 Contribution 3 的核心方法论，需要更强的支撑。 -  修复方案 : 补充 sentence embedding（SimCSE/SBERT）对比验证，或在 Limitations 中更显著地讨论此限制。 W9: Degeneration condition (Eq. 4) 推导不完备。  [ R1-W6(should-fix) ]\\n 从 constraint coupling 到 score 退化为 majority voting 的推导缺少关键步骤——需假设 SAT 检查在退化 regime 下几乎不淘汰约束。 -  修复方案 : 补充退化条件下 constraint rejection rate 的经验证据，或标注 Eq. 4 为 approximate。 W10: \\\"Symbolic Mirage\\\" 术语精确度。  [ R2-W5(should-fix), R1-rebut ]\\n \\\"Mirage\\\" 暗示约束方法论整体失效，但 Oracle 实验证明机制有效。R2 认为命名误导，R1 认为有教学价值但需 scoping。分歧点。 -  修复方案 : 保留术语但在首次出现时明确定义范围：\\\"self-extraction 产生的约束是 mirage，而非符号约束方法论本身\\\"。 Minor W11 : α=0.5 penalty weight 无 sensitivity analysis 或 justification。[ R1-W7 ]\\n W12 : GSM8K (n=30) / AIME (n=22) 在 Table 1 中与大样本条件并列，应加分区标注。[ R1-W8 ]\\n W13 : orphan bib entry  press2023compositionality 。[ R1-W9, R2-W6 ]\\n W14 : Reasoning models (o1, R1, QwQ) 未在 §2 作为独立类别讨论。[ R2-W7 ]\\n W15 : 部分 bib author name 与 OpenAlex 记录不一致，建议核实。[ R2-W6 ] Reviewer Consensus 以下问题两位 Reviewer 达成共识 [ AGREE ]： 1.  统计功效不足是核心缺陷 ——标题/abstract 的 \\\"Fail\\\" 断言超出统计证据支撑，需要 TOST equivalence test 或措辞修正。 2.  跨架构 PoC 需要多重比较校正 ——p=0.013 在 6+ comparisons 下不再显著。 3.  CJT/Fleiss' κ 框架的定量使用需要更严格的 justification 。 4.  TF-IDF 作为 process-level independence 指标过于粗糙 ，需补充验证或加强 limitation 讨论。 5.  CLOVER 等关键引用缺失 需要补充。 6.  Oracle 控制是全文最强实验 ，确认聚合机制有效。 7.  实验覆盖面广、统计报告诚实 是显著优势。 Reviewer Divergence 新颖性评估 （主要分歧）： -  R2 （3.0/5 Excitement → 2.5）：核心发现可从 Huang (2024) + Stechly (2025) 合理预期，\\\"Symbolic Confirmation Bias\\\" 是已知结论在符号域的实例化。论文需更清晰论证定量工具的增量价值。 -  R1 （3.5/5 Excitement → 3.5）：虽然定性方向可预期，但 Effective-K 框架、BR 指标、process-level independence 的定量化是真正的新贡献，为社区提供了分析 self-verification 失败的可复用工具。 -  Director 判断 : R2 的新颖性担忧有理有据——一个 well-informed reader 确实可以从已有文献推断出 \\\"self-extracted symbolic constraints will inherit model bias\\\"。论文的增量价值在于定量化程度和实验规模，但这需要在论文中被显式论证。当前论文未充分做到这一点。 \\\"Symbolic Mirage\\\" 术语 （次要分歧）： -  R2 认为术语 marketing-like 且误导（Oracle 证明机制有效）；R1 认为有教学价值。 -  Director 判断 : 术语可保留但需更精确的 scoping。 Questions Q1  [ R1]: Symbolic Mirage 假说 (Eq. 5) 的概率空间定义需要更精确——E_ θ 的定义、条件化的 σ-algebra、\\\"·\\\" 的含义均不清楚。 Q2  [ R1 ]: K sensitivity 中 K=8 时 Δ≈+4.90pp 是否值得更深入分析？non-monotonicity 可能指向约束冗余度与 K 的关系。 Q3  [ R1]: T_ ext=0.3 的选择依据？是否做过 extraction temperature sensitivity analysis？ Q4  [ R2 ]: QwQ-32B 在 Type A 条件下无 significant degradation——reasoning models 的 CoT 结构是否缓解 confirmation bias？ Q5  [ R2 ]: ProofWriter Oracle 的 gold constraints 如何构造？DSL 自动转换 vs 人工标注？ Q6  [ R1/R2 ]: 跨架构 PoC 为何仅在 FOLIO/ProofWriter 测试？是否尝试过其他外部信号源（不同 LLM family 作为 extractor, code execution verification）？ Missing References 1. 1	Self-Consistency (SC) majority voting over chain-of-thought traces saturates as sample count grows because same-model traces are correlated voters.

Self-Consistency (SC) majority voting over chain-of-thought traces saturates as sample count grows because same-model traces are correlated voters.
We investigate whether symbolic constraint extraction can break this plateau through Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation (SICA), which extracts first-order logic (FOL) constraints from reasoning traces and selects answers via weighted partial MAX-SAT.
Evaluating six models (7B--32B) across three reasoning domains with over 3,000 condition-evaluations (${\sim}$1,250 unique instances), we find that self-extracted constraints do not improve majority voting: none of fifteen non-degenerate conditions shows a significant positive effect; TOST equivalence tests (margin $\pm 2$\,pp) establish equivalence for four conditions, while five show genuine SICA--SC differences---four of which are negative.
We identify \emph{symbolic confirmation bias} as the root cause: on incorrect problems, 83.3\% of self-extracted constraints support the wrong majority answer (bias ratio $4.97\times$), and 94\% of errors overlap with SC.
Process-level analysis reveals a deeper bottleneck: chain-of-thought cosine similarity ($0.69$) far exceeds answer-level Fleiss' $\kappa$ ($0.41$), indicating that traces share reasoning processes even when they diverge on answers.
Twenty-plus same-model remediation strategies spanning fifteen families all fail, revealing a persistent independence-accuracy trade-off at the 7B--32B scale: methods that increase trace independence destroy accuracy (Debate: $\kappa = 0.15$, $-18.6$\,pp), while methods preserving accuracy cannot break the correlation floor ($\kappa \geq 0.40$ across three model families).
Oracle controls confirm the aggregation mechanism is sound ($+29.90$\,pp and $+14.22$\,pp on FOLIO, $+11.50$\,pp ProofWriter; $p < 0.001$); same-model self-extraction captures only ${\sim}$12\% of the oracle ceiling.
However, a cross-architecture proof-of-concept---DeBERTa-large NLI combined with SC---shows consistent positive effects across two datasets ($+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter, $p = 0.013$; McNemar exact test), suggesting that the oracle gap is partially recoverable when verification signal comes from outside the reasoning model's distribution.

# Review Report Action Matrix

## 硬约束
收到审稿报告后**禁止**整体性 "已知悉" 回复。必须**先做 Holistic Pass,再做 Per-Comment Action Matrix**。

## Step 1: Holistic Pass（整体审视，action matrix 之前必做）

审稿意见不是独立的,经常多条指向同一个系统性问题。切碎成多条独立 action 会漏掉根因。

1. **聚类**：把所有审稿意见按主题聚类（method design / experiment design / claim strength / writing clarity / novelty / related work）
2. **识别系统性问题**：任何一个 cluster 含 ≥ 3 条意见 → 标记为 `[SYSTEMIC_ISSUE]`,不再切碎成独立 action,作为单独根因处理
3. **矩阵回溯**：如果 SYSTEMIC_ISSUE 指向 core method design → 立即触发 `experiment-matrix` skill 回顾:
   - 现有实验矩阵在新的 method 理解下还有几格有效？
   - 哪些之前的 positive 实验可能因此失效（method 基础变了）？
   - 哪些格子要重新跑？
4. **全局影响评估**：SYSTEMIC_ISSUE 是否影响论文 core claim？如果是 → 必须子调 `red-section` 做 framing 评估,然后再动 action matrix

**Holistic Pass 输出写入 ROADMAP.md 的"审稿回溯·系统性问题"section**,先于 action matrix。

## Step 2: Action Matrix 格式

| 审稿意见 ID | 内容摘要 | 类别 | 动作 | 负责人 | ETA |
|-----------|--------|------|------|-------|-----|
| R1.1 | 缺某 ablation | 补实验 | 让 Agent 铺 exp_XXX | Agent | 2d |
| R1.2 | Claim 过强 | 改 paper | 调 red-section 重写 intro | Agent | 1d |
| R1.3 | 某 method 解释不清 | 写 rebuttal | Director 写 rebuttal 论点 | Director | 1d |
| R2.1 | Core claim 不成立 | framing 调整 | 子调 red-section + 改矩阵 | Agent + Director | 5d |

## 类别
- **补实验**：必须让 Agent 铺实验（可与 rebuttal 并行）
- **改 paper**：让 Agent 调 red-section 后改章节
- **写 rebuttal**：Director 主笔
- **拒绝**：有理由的拒绝（写入 action matrix 的"拒绝理由"字段）

## 产出
- action matrix 写入 ROADMAP.md 的"审稿回溯"section
- 决策日志同步（`log_decision`）
- 补实验条目立即调度（不等 rebuttal 写完）
- 如果有 "framing 调整" 类别 → 子调 red-section skill

## Step 3: 同步 Issue Tracker（必做）

action matrix 定稿后,同步更新跨轮次 Issue Tracker `artifacts/review_issues.yaml`:

1. 用 `read_local_file("projects/{project}/artifacts/review_issues.yaml")` 读当前 tracker（不存在则视为空）
2. 对 action matrix 中每条:
   - 找到对应的 issue ID（同一 cluster / 相似 summary）
   - 把 `status` 从 `open` 翻到 `in_progress`
   - 在 `action_items` 里追加本轮 action（含 round / action / assigned_to / status）
3. 对上轮标 `in_progress` 且本轮 Reviewer 已确认修复（`[RESOLVED]`）的:
   - `status` 改为 `resolved`,记 `resolution_round` 和 `resolution`
4. 调 `update_review_issues(project, issues_yaml=完整 YAML)` 写回

## 提交下一轮审稿（如适用）

调 `submit_paper_to_review` 时根据情景设 `recommended_review_mode`:

- **`continue`**：刚迭代修了上轮问题,需要 Reviewer 带着上轮记忆验证修复效果
- **`fresh`**：做了重大 reframing / 距上次审稿 >48h / 论文结构大改 → 想要不受干扰的客观评估

同时在 `mode_reason` 写一句推荐理由。人类仍可在审批卡片上覆盖。

1	\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}
2	
3	Test-time computation scaling through multiple reasoning samples has emerged as a practical alternative to scaling model parameters \citep{snell2025scaling, guo2025deepseekr1}.
4	The dominant aggregation strategy, Self-Consistency (SC) \citep{wang2023sc}, samples $K$ chain-of-thought traces and selects the majority answer.
5	SC is simple, model-agnostic, and effective---but it is hitting a ceiling.
6	\citet{loo2025reevaluating} demonstrate that gains from increasing $K$ plateau and even decline for strong models.
7	The gap between SC's theoretical promise (independent correct voters converge to truth) and its practical behavior (saturating gains) points to a structural mismatch: same-model traces carry correlated errors, and majority voting has no mechanism to correct shared bias.
8	
9	Confidence-weighted \citep{taubenfeld2025cisc} and universal \citep{chen2024usc} extensions alleviate this, but the core limitation persists.
10	Recent neuro-symbolic methods \citep{pan2023logiclm, olausson2023linc, xu2026dylos, li2025aristotle, wang2025fover, luo2025logicagent} report gains on logical reasoning but introduce components beyond the reasoning model.
11	A simpler question precedes these: can the \emph{same} model extract useful formal constraints from its own traces---a zero-cost upgrade requiring no additional model or data?
12	No prior work has systematically evaluated this.
13	
14	We ground our analysis in the Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) \citep{condorcet1785}: if $K$ independent voters each answer correctly with probability $p > 0.5$, the majority converges to truth \citep{austensmith1996}.
15	When independence fails \citep{ladha1992correlated}, additional samples carry diminishing information.
16	Measuring inter-trace agreement with Fleiss' $\kappa$ \citep{fleiss1971kappa}, we find $\kappa = 0.21$--$0.82$ across instruction-tuned conditions, yielding Effective-$K = 1.20$--$3.62$ for nominal $K = 12$: traces beyond a dozen add negligible independent information (\S\ref{sec:effective-k}).
17	The bottleneck runs deeper than answer-level agreement suggests.
18	Chain-of-thought cosine similarity ($0.69$) far exceeds answer-level $\kappa$ ($0.41$), revealing that traces share reasoning processes even when they diverge on final answers (\S\ref{sec:process-kappa}).
19	When the same model extracts FOL constraints from these correlated traces, the constraints exhibit \emph{symbolic confirmation bias}: on problems where the model errs, 83.3\% of self-extracted constraints support the wrong majority answer (bias ratio $4.97\times$), and 94\% of errors overlap with SC (\S\ref{sec:confirmation-bias}).
20	Self-extraction cannot supply the independent signal that CJT requires.
21	
22	We study this through Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation (SICA): extract FOL constraints from each of $K$ reasoning traces, deduplicate by syntactic equivalence, and select the answer best supported by a weighted partial MAX-SAT solution via Z3 \citep{demoura2008z3} (\S\ref{sec:pipeline}; Figure~\ref{fig:pipeline}).
23	We evaluate SICA across six models (7B--32B), three reasoning domains (FOLIO \citep{han2022folio}, ProofWriter \citep{tafjord2021proofwriter}, LogiQA \citep{liu2020logiqa}), and over 3,000 condition-evaluations (${\sim}$1,250 unique instances) with four-seed replication (Table~\ref{tab:main_results}).
24	Twenty-plus remediation strategies spanning fifteen families---from prompt engineering through method-level redesign---all produce neutral or negative results, confirming the bottleneck is persistent at the 7B--32B scale.
25	
26	Oracle controls confirm the aggregation mechanism is sound: same-model gold FOL yields $+29.90$\,pp (Mistral-7B) and $+14.22$\,pp (Qwen-14B) on FOLIO ($p < 0.001$), yet self-extraction captures only ${\sim}$12\% of the same-model ceiling (\S\ref{sec:oracle}).
27	The central finding is a persistent independence-accuracy trade-off: Debate reduces $\kappa$ from 0.44 to 0.15 (tripling Eff-$K$) but collapses accuracy by $-18.6$\,pp; SC, Diverse-Prompt, and ICG all cluster at $\kappa \approx 0.40$--$0.47$, forming a same-model ceiling that holds across three model families (\S\ref{sec:remediation}).
28	A cross-architecture proof-of-concept suggests this gap is recoverable: DeBERTa-large NLI combined with SC yields $+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter ($p = 0.013$, McNemar exact test) with consistent positive trends across datasets (\S\ref{sec:cross-arch}).
29	
30	Our contributions are:
31	\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
32	\item \textbf{Independence-Accuracy Trade-off.} Same-model $\kappa \geq 0.40$ across four methods and three model families; twenty-plus remediation strategies (fifteen families) fail. A cross-architecture NLI verifier ($+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter, $p = 0.013$) suggests the ceiling is escapable (\S\ref{sec:remediation}, \S\ref{sec:cross-arch}).
33

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}

Test-time computation scaling through multiple reasoning samples has emerged as a practical alternative to scaling model parameters \citep{snell2025scaling, guo2025deepseekr1}.
The dominant aggregation strategy, Self-Consistency (SC) \citep{wang2023sc}, samples $K$ chain-of-thought traces and selects the majority answer.
SC is simple, model-agnostic, and effective---but it is hitting a ceiling.
\citet{loo2025reevaluating} demonstrate that gains from increasing $K$ plateau and even decline for strong models.
The gap between SC's theoretical promise (independent correct voters converge to truth) and its practical behavior (saturating gains) points to a structural mismatch: same-model traces carry correlated errors, and majority voting has no mechanism to correct shared bias.

Confidence-weighted \citep{taubenfeld2025cisc} and universal \citep{chen2024usc} extensions alleviate this, but the core limitation persists.
Recent neuro-symbolic methods \citep{pan2023logiclm, olausson2023linc, xu2026dylos, li2025aristotle, wang2025fover, luo2025logicagent} report gains on logical reasoning but introduce components beyond the reasoning model.
A simpler question precedes these: can the \emph{same} model extract useful formal constraints from its own traces---a zero-cost upgrade requiring no additional model or data?
No prior work has systematically evaluated this.

We ground our analysis in the Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) \citep{condorcet1785}: if $K$ independent voters each answer correctly with probability $p > 0.5$, the majority converges to truth \citep{austensmith1996}.
When independence fails \citep{ladha1992correlated}, additional samples carry diminishing information.
Measuring inter-trace agreement with Fleiss' $\kappa$ \citep{fleiss1971kappa}, we find $\kappa = 0.21$--$0.82$ across instruction-tuned conditions, yielding Effective-$K = 1.20$--$3.62$ for nominal $K = 12$: traces beyond a dozen add negligible independent information (\S\ref{sec:effective-k}).
The bottleneck runs deeper than answer-level agreement suggests.
Chain-of-thought cosine similarity ($0.69$) far exceeds answer-level $\kappa$ ($0.41$), revealing that traces share reasoning processes even when they diverge on final answers (\S\ref{sec:process-kappa}).
When the same model extracts FOL constraints from these correlated traces, the constraints exhibit \emph{symbolic confirmation bias}: on problems where the model errs, 83.3\% of self-extracted constraints support the wrong majority answer (bias ratio $4.97\times$), and 94\% of errors overlap with SC (\S\ref{sec:confirmation-bias}).
Self-extraction cannot supply the independent signal that CJT requires.

We study this through Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation (SICA): extract FOL constraints from each of $K$ reasoning traces, deduplicate by syntactic equivalence, and select the answer best supported by a weighted partial MAX-SAT solution via Z3 \citep{demoura2008z3} (\S\ref{sec:pipeline}; Figure~\ref{fig:pipeline}).
We evaluate SICA across six models (7B--32B), three reasoning domains (FOLIO \citep{han2022folio}, ProofWriter \citep{tafjord2021proofwriter}, LogiQA \citep{liu2020logiqa}), and over 3,000 condition-evaluations (${\sim}$1,250 unique instances) with four-seed replication (Table~\ref{tab:main_results}).
Twenty-plus remediation strategies spanning fifteen families---from prompt engineering through method-level redesign---all produce neutral or negative results, confirming the bottleneck is persistent at the 7B--32B scale.

Oracle controls confirm the aggregation mechanism is sound: same-model gold FOL yields $+29.90$\,pp (Mistral-7B) and $+14.22$\,pp (Qwen-14B) on FOLIO ($p < 0.001$), yet self-extraction captures only ${\sim}$12\% of the same-model ceiling (\S\ref{sec:oracle}).
The central finding is a persistent independence-accuracy trade-off: Debate reduces $\kappa$ from 0.44 to 0.15 (tripling Eff-$K$) but collapses accuracy by $-18.6$\,pp; SC, Diverse-Prompt, and ICG all cluster at $\kappa \approx 0.40$--$0.47$, forming a same-model ceiling that holds across three model families (\S\ref{sec:remediation}).
A cross-architecture proof-of-concept suggests this gap is recoverable: DeBERTa-large NLI combined with SC yields $+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter ($p = 0.013$, McNemar exact test) with consistent positive trends across datasets (\S\ref{sec:cross-arch}).

Our contributions are:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Independence-Accuracy Trade-off.} Same-model $\kappa \geq 0.40$ across four methods and three model families; twenty-plus remediation strategies (fifteen families) fail. A cross-architecture NLI verifier ($+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter, $p = 0.013$) suggests the ceiling is escapable (\S\ref{sec:remediation}, \S\ref{sec:cross-arch}).

\item \textbf{Symbolic Confirmation Bias.} On incorrect problems, 83.3\% of self-extracted constraints support the wrong majority answer (bias ratio $4.97\times$), and 94\% of errors overlap with SC (\S\ref{sec:confirmation-bias}).

\item \textbf{Process-Level Independence.} Across four model families, CoT cosine similarity ($0.69$--$0.79$) far exceeds answer-level $\kappa$ ($0.45$--$0.74$); the gap intensifies with model capability, showing reasoning homogeneity is architecture-independent (\S\ref{sec:process-kappa}).
\end{enumerate}

2	All models range from 7B to 32B parameters; whether the independence bottleneck persists at larger scales (70B+) or with reasoning-specialized models is untested. 3	
4	\paragraph{Statistical power.}
5	The per-label complementarity analysis of the cross-architecture NLI result (\S\ref{sec:cross-arch}) involves small cell sizes (e.g., 42 \textsc{False} problems, 69 \textsc{Unknown} problems); per-label McNemar tests would be underpowered. The bias ratio metric ($4.97\times$) was initially computed on a single condition (Mistral-7B FOLIO, $n = 204$); cross-model replication (Table~\ref{tab:cross-model-bias}) confirms the pattern but is limited to FOLIO. Four-seed replication shows 2 of 4 seeds yielding null or negative results, and the intermediate-SC region is narrow (SC $\approx$ 50--55\%). The process-level similarity metric uses TF-IDF representations (a lower bound on true process similarity). Pairwise Pearson $r$ between traces (mean $0.625$, Mistral-7B) is monotonically related to Fleiss' $\kappa$ across all four model families, supporting $\kappa$ as a valid consensus proxy despite the simplifying assumptions of Eq.~\ref{eq:effk}.
6	
7	\paragraph{Computational cost trade-off.}
8	SICA requires $4.5\times$ the wall-clock time of SC (81.4 vs.\ 17.7\,min for 204 questions at $K{=}12$), with constraint extraction accounting for 76\% of overhead (\S\ref{sec:exp-setup}). This $3.5\times$ additional cost yields no significant accuracy gain on any condition, making the method impractical in its current form. Alternative prompting strategies (few-shot, chain-of-thought extraction) might improve extraction quality, though the oracle gap suggests the bottleneck is structural. Additional limitations regarding power analysis and deduplication strategy are discussed in Appendix~\ref{app:limitations-extended}.
9	
10	\paragraph{Reproducibility.} All code, data, and experimental scripts will be released upon publication to facilitate replication of SICA, the oracle controls, and all remediation experiments.

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:introduction}

Test-time computation scaling through multiple reasoning samples has emerged as a practical alternative to scaling model parameters \citep{snell2025scaling, guo2025deepseekr1}.
The dominant aggregation strategy, Self-Consistency (SC) \citep{wang2023sc}, samples $K$ chain-of-thought traces and selects the majority answer.
SC is simple, model-agnostic, and effective---but it is hitting a ceiling.
\citet{loo2025reevaluating} demonstrate that gains from increasing $K$ plateau and even decline for strong models.
The gap between SC's theoretical promise (independent correct voters converge to truth) and its practical behavior (saturating gains) points to a structural mismatch: same-model traces carry correlated errors, and majority voting has no mechanism to correct shared bias.

Confidence-weighted \citep{taubenfeld2025cisc} and universal \citep{chen2024usc} extensions alleviate this, but the core limitation persists.
Recent neuro-symbolic methods \citep{pan2023logiclm, olausson2023linc, xu2026dylos, li2025aristotle, wang2025fover, luo2025logicagent} report gains on logical reasoning but introduce components beyond the reasoning model.
A simpler question precedes these: can the \emph{same} model extract useful formal constraints from its own traces---a zero-cost upgrade requiring no additional model or data?
No prior work has systematically evaluated this.

We ground our analysis in the Condorcet Jury Theorem (CJT) \citep{condorcet1785}: if $K$ independent voters each answer correctly with probability $p > 0.5$, the majority converges to truth \citep{austensmith1996}.
When independence fails \citep{ladha1992correlated}, additional samples carry diminishing information.
Measuring inter-trace agreement with Fleiss' $\kappa$ \citep{fleiss1971kappa}, we find $\kappa = 0.21$--$0.82$ across instruction-tuned conditions, yielding Effective-$K = 1.20$--$3.62$ for nominal $K = 12$: traces beyond a dozen add negligible independent information (\S\ref{sec:effective-k}).
The bottleneck runs deeper than answer-level agreement suggests.
Chain-of-thought cosine similarity ($0.69$) far exceeds answer-level $\kappa$ ($0.41$), revealing that traces share reasoning processes even when they diverge on final answers (\S\ref{sec:process-kappa}).
When the same model extracts FOL constraints from these correlated traces, the constraints exhibit \emph{symbolic confirmation bias}: on problems where the model errs, 83.3\% of self-extracted constraints support the wrong majority answer (bias ratio $4.97\times$), and 94\% of errors overlap with SC (\S\ref{sec:confirmation-bias}).
Self-extraction cannot supply the independent signal that CJT requires.

We study this through Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation (SICA): extract FOL constraints from each of $K$ reasoning traces, deduplicate by syntactic equivalence, and select the answer best supported by a weighted partial MAX-SAT solution via Z3 \citep{demoura2008z3} (\S\ref{sec:pipeline}; Figure~\ref{fig:pipeline}).
We evaluate SICA across six models (7B--32B), three reasoning domains (FOLIO \citep{han2022folio}, ProofWriter \citep{tafjord2021proofwriter}, LogiQA \citep{liu2020logiqa}), and over 3,000 condition-evaluations (${\sim}$1,250 unique instances) with four-seed replication (Table~\ref{tab:main_results}).
Twenty-plus remediation strategies spanning fifteen families---from prompt engineering through method-level redesign---all produce neutral or negative results, confirming the bottleneck is persistent at the 7B--32B scale.
Prior work qualitatively concludes that LLMs cannot self-correct \citep{huang2024selfcorrect} or self-verify \citep{stechly2025selfverification} without external feedback.
We extend these findings with three quantitative tools: reusable continuous diagnostics (Effective-$K$, bias ratio) applicable to any trace-aggregation system; evidence that formal Z3-checked FOL verification also fails, extending beyond prompt-level self-correction; and process-level analysis revealing reasoning homogeneity invisible to answer-only metrics.

Oracle controls confirm the aggregation mechanism is sound: same-model gold FOL yields $+29.90$\,pp (Mistral-7B) and $+14.22$\,pp (Qwen-14B) on FOLIO ($p < 0.001$), yet self-extraction captures only ${\sim}$12\% of the same-model ceiling (\S\ref{sec:oracle}).
The central finding is a persistent independence-accuracy trade-off: Debate reduces $\kappa$ from 0.44 to 0.15 (tripling Eff-$K$) but collapses accuracy by $-18.6$\,pp; SC, Diverse-Prompt, and ICG all cluster at $\kappa \approx 0.40$--$0.47$, forming a same-model ceiling that holds across three model families (\S\ref{sec:remediation}).
A cross-architecture proof-of-concept suggests this gap is recoverable: DeBERTa-large NLI combined with SC yields $+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter ($p = 0.013$, McNemar exact test) with consistent positive trends across datasets (\S\ref{sec:cross-arch}).

Our contributions are:
\begin{enumerate}[nosep,leftmargin=*]
\item \textbf{Independence-Accuracy Trade-off.} Same-model $\kappa \geq 0.40$ across four methods and three model families; twenty-plus remediation strategies (fifteen families) fail. A cross-architecture NLI verifier ($+3.50$\,pp on ProofWriter, $p = 0.013$) suggests the ceiling is escapable (\S\ref{sec:remediation}, \S\ref{sec:cross-arch}).

\item \textbf{Symbolic Confirmation Bias.} On incorrect problems, 83.3\% of self-extracted constraints support the wrong majority answer (bias ratio $4.97\times$), and 94\% of errors overlap with SC (\S\ref{sec:confirmation-bias}).

\item \textbf{Process-Level Independence.} Across four model families, CoT cosine similarity ($0.69$--$0.79$) far exceeds answer-level $\kappa$ ($0.45$--$0.74$); the gap intensifies with model capability, showing reasoning homogeneity is architecture-independent (\S\ref{sec:process-kappa}).
\end{enumerate}
